[M] That's true. And if our projections are correct, we can expect around 500 people to attend. But we need to have a site selected by the end of next month.
[W] We have some possibilities in mind. We'll know soon if any of them will work out.
part3.explanation: Người đàn ông nói rõ con số dự kiến: 'if our projections are correct, we can expect around 500 people to attend' (chúng ta có thể kỳ vọng khoảng 500 người tham dự). Đáp án C (Five hundred) chính xác.
part3.translation: Họ dự kiến có bao nhiêu người tham dự hội nghị? - (C) Năm trăm người.

part4.question: What is the topic of the talk?
part4.transcript: All conference facilities need to provide reasonable accommodation for people with disabilities. Disabled individuals need to be able to take part in every session that is being offered. In case a session is held in an off-site location, we are not responsible for providing accommodation. But for any event held at our facility, we need to make the necessary arrangements for disabled participants. Most areas of our facility are handicapped accessible, but in some situations we need to make further accommodations. For example, conference planners are asked to get in touch with us ahead of time if any attendees will require special interpreters for the hearing impaired. To facilitate this, conference planners usually ask attendees to request interpreters at the time that they register for the conference.
part4.explanation: Người nói mở đầu bài nói bằng nguyên tắc: 'All conference facilities need to provide reasonable accommodation for people with disabilities. Disabled individuals need to be able to take part...' Toàn bộ bài nói phổ biến việc sắp xếp hỗ trợ người khuyết tật (Accommodating disabled people). Đáp án A chính xác.
part4.translation: Chủ đề của bài nói là gì? - (A) Thu xếp điều kiện hỗ trợ cho người khuyết tật.

part4.question: Where are the speakers?
part4.transcript: All conference facilities need to provide reasonable accommodation for people with disabilities. Disabled individuals need to be able to take part in every session that is being offered. In case a session is held in an off-site location, we are not responsible for providing accommodation. But for any event held at our facility, we need to make the necessary arrangements for disabled participants. Most areas of our facility are handicapped accessible, but in some situations we need to make further accommodations. For example, conference planners are asked to get in touch with us ahead of time if any attendees will require special interpreters for the hearing impaired. To facilitate this, conference planners usually ask attendees to request interpreters at the time that they register for the conference.
part4.explanation: Người nói nói về: 'conference facilities', 'our facility', 'handicapped accessible', 'conference planners are asked to get in touch with us ahead of time'. Người nói là người đại diện của trung tâm hội nghị đang phát biểu tại chính trung tâm hội nghị (At a convention center). Đáp án D chính xác.
part4.translation: Những người nói đang ở đâu? - (D) Tại một trung tâm hội nghị.

part4.question: How should attendees request a special interpreter?

options.text: By asking for one at the time of registration.
By getting in touch with the head of the facility.
By registering ahead of the other attendees.
By requesting one when they arrive at a session

part4.transcript: All conference facilities need to provide reasonable accommodation for people with disabilities. Disabled individuals need to be able to take part in every session that is being offered. In case a session is held in an off-site location, we are not responsible for providing accommodation. But for any event held at our facility, we need to make the necessary arrangements for disabled participants. Most areas of our facility are handicapped accessible, but in some situations we need to make further accommodations. For example, conference planners are asked to get in touch with us ahead of time if any attendees will require special interpreters for the hearing impaired. To facilitate this, conference planners usually ask attendees to request interpreters at the time that they register for the conference.
part4.explanation: Người nói cho biết giải pháp: 'conference planners usually ask attendees to request interpreters at the time that they register for the conference' (người lên kế hoạch thường yêu cầu người tham gia đăng ký yêu cầu thông dịch viên vào lúc họ đăng ký hội nghị). Đáp án A chính xác.
part4.translation: Những người tham dự nên yêu cầu thông dịch viên đặc biệt bằng cách nào? - (A) Bằng cách yêu cầu vào thời điểm đăng ký.

part5.question: The banquet room could _______ up to 750 for dinner.
part5.explanation: Sau modal verb 'could' bắt buộc là một động từ nguyên mẫu không 'to' (V-bare): (B) accommodate (v - chứa được, đáp ứng chỗ cho). (A) accommodated là quá khứ; (C) accommodation là danh từ; (D) accommodating là V-ing.
part5.translation: Phòng tiệc lớn có thể chứa được tới 750 người cho bữa tối.

part5.question: Helen made the final _______ for use of the conference room with the hotel’s general manager.
part5.explanation: Cụm collocation kinh doanh phổ biến: 'make arrangements for sth' (thu xếp/sắp đặt cho việc gì). Sau mạo từ 'the' và tính từ 'final' cần một danh từ (Noun): (C) arrangement. (A) V-ing; (B) động từ; (D) quá khứ/phân từ.
part5.translation: Helen đã tiến hành việc sắp xếp cuối cùng cho việc sử dụng phòng hội nghị với tổng giám đốc khách sạn.

part5.question: For most people, Samco is _______ with computer chip production.
part5.explanation: Cấu trúc tính từ/bị động đi với giới từ 'with': 'be associated with sth' (gắn liền với, liên kết với cái gì). (B) associated là dạng quá khứ phân từ chính xác. (A) động từ nguyên mẫu; (C) V-ing; (D) danh từ hiệp hội.
part5.translation: Đối với hầu hết mọi người, Samco gắn liền với việc sản xuất vi mạch máy tính.

part5.question: We expect that fewer guests will _______ the evening gala.
part5.explanation: Sau trợ động từ khiếm khuyết 'will' cần động từ nguyên mẫu không 'to' (V-bare): (A) attend (v - tham dự). (B) V-ing; (C) danh từ sự chú ý; (D) danh từ số lượng người tham dự.
part5.translation: Chúng tôi dự đoán rằng sẽ có ít khách mời tham dự đêm dạ tiệc hơn.

part5.question: The association’s members were asked to _______ for the special session well in advance because space in the lecture hall was limited.
part5.explanation: Cấu trúc thể bị động với động từ nguyên mẫu có 'to': 'be asked to + V-bare' (được yêu cầu làm việc gì). Sau 'to' cần động từ nguyên thể (A) register (đăng ký). (B) danh từ sự đăng ký; (C) V-ing; (D) danh từ nhân viên đăng ký.
part5.translation: Các thành viên của hiệp hội được yêu cầu đăng ký cho phiên họp đặc biệt từ sớm vì chỗ ngồi trong giảng đường có hạn.

part5.question: By adding more class _______, the staff was able to please more members.
part5.explanation: Sau danh từ bổ nghĩa 'class' cần một danh từ số nhiều (Plural Noun) để làm tân ngữ cho cụm 'adding more...': (D) selections (các sự lựa chọn, các khóa/lớp được chọn). (A) động từ; (B) tính từ chọn lọc; (C) V-ing.
part5.translation: Bằng việc bổ sung thêm nhiều lựa chọn lớp học, ban nhân viên đã có thể làm hài lòng nhiều thành viên hơn.

part6.title: Annual Conference - Countywide Small Business Owners Association
part6.passage:
All members of the Countywide Small Business Owners Association are invited to take part in our annual conference, to be held on March 31 at the Grand Hotel in Marysville.

The conference begins at 8:30 A.M. with an address by this year's guest, Cynthia Quinn, owner of Designs by Cynthia, Inc., and winner of numerous business and community awards. Morning small group sessions begin at 9:30. Attendees can [16] from a variety of session topics including Financing Your New Business; Selecting the Best Location; and Formulas for Success. Lunch will be served at 12:30, followed by afternoon small group sessions at 2:00.

This is the Association's most popular event, so [17] early to assure your place. Fill out the form below and send it to the Association Secretary by March 1. To arrange overnight [18] at the Grand Hotel, get in touch with the hotel reservations clerk at 498-1231. Mention the conference in order to get a special discount price.

questions.question: Question 16 (Select the best word/phrase)
questions.explanation: Sau modal verb 'can' cần một động từ nguyên mẫu không 'to' (V-bare): (A) select (chọn lựa). Cụm 'select from a variety of topics' (lựa chọn từ nhiều chủ đề phiên họp). (B) danh từ; (C) tính từ; (D) trạng từ. Chọn A.
questions.translation: [16] Người tham dự có thể lựa chọn từ nhiều chủ đề phiên thảo luận đa dạng...

questions.question: Question 17 (Select the best word/phrase)
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề sau liên từ 'so' là một câu mệnh lệnh (Imperative sentence) khuyên người đọc hành động, đứng đầu câu mệnh lệnh bắt buộc là động từ nguyên mẫu (V-bare): (D) register (hãy đăng ký sớm để đảm bảo giữ chỗ). (A) tương lai; (B) động từ tình thái; (C) V-ing. Chọn D.
questions.translation: [17] hãy đăng ký sớm để đảm bảo giữ được chỗ của bạn.

questions.question: Question 18 (Select the best word/phrase)
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ 'overnight' (qua đêm) cần một danh từ số nhiều chỉ nơi ăn chốn ở / phòng nghỉ: (C) accommodations (nơi ăn chốn ở, chỗ lưu trú). Cụm 'overnight accommodations' (chỗ nghỉ qua đêm). (A) động từ; (B) V-ing; (D) động từ chia ngôi 3. Chọn C.
questions.translation: [18] Để thu xếp chỗ nghỉ qua đêm tại Khách sạn Grand, vui lòng liên hệ với nhân viên đặt phòng...

part7.title: Two E-mails Regarding Conference Venue Selection

questions.question: What are these e-mails about?

options.text: The topics of the conference sessions

questions.explanation: Cả hai email trao đổi về việc lựa chọn giữa City Convention Center và Mayfield Hotel để tổ chức hội nghị sắp tới. Nội dung chính xoay quanh địa điểm tổ chức hội nghị (The conference site). Đáp án B chính xác.
questions.translation: Những bức email này nói về điều gì? - (B) Địa điểm tổ chức hội nghị.

questions.question: How many meeting rooms will they need?
questions.explanation: Trong email thứ hai, Max nhắc nhở: 'Remember, we plan to hold at least five sessions at a time. We couldn't do that at the hotel' (Hãy nhớ rằng chúng ta dự định tổ chức ít nhất 5 phiên họp cùng một lúc). Để tổ chức 5 phiên họp cùng lúc thì cần ít nhất 5 phòng họp (At least five). Đáp án B chính xác.
questions.translation: Họ sẽ cần bao nhiêu phòng họp? - (B) Ít nhất năm phòng.

questions.question: What does Max prefer about the Convention Center?
questions.explanation: Max giải thích lý do chọn Trung tâm Hội nghị: 'The hotel is much too small... so it is important to have a space that can accommodate everyone' (Khách sạn quá nhỏ... quan trọng là phải có không gian đủ sức chứa cho mọi người). Điều Max ưu tiên và thích ở Trung tâm Hội nghị chính là diện tích rộng lớn (The size). Đáp án C chính xác.
questions.translation: Max thích điều gì hơn ở Trung tâm Hội nghị? - (C) Quy mô/kích thước rộng lớn.

questions.question: The word "get in touch" in the first e-mail are closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Trong email thứ nhất có câu: 'Please get in touch with me today to let me know what you think' (Xin hãy liên lạc với tôi hôm nay để tôi biết ý kiến của bạn). Cụm từ 'get in touch' đồng nghĩa hoàn toàn với 'contact' (liên lạc). Đáp án D chính xác.
questions.translation: Cụm từ 'get in touch' ở dòng 14 của email thứ nhất gần nghĩa nhất với: - (D) contact (liên lạc).

questions.question: The word "selecting" in the second e-mail is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Trong email thứ hai mở đầu bằng: 'In regard to selecting a location for the conference...' (Liên quan đến việc lựa chọn địa điểm cho hội nghị...). Từ 'selecting' đồng nghĩa với 'choosing' (lựa chọn, tuyển chọn). Đáp án A chính xác.
questions.translation: Từ 'selecting' ở dòng 1 của email thứ hai gần nghĩa nhất với: - (A) choosing (lựa chọn).

part7.passage:
To: Max Sullivan
From: Martha Reynolds
Subj: Conference

Max,

I have been working on the arrangements for our upcoming conference. I've looked into the City Convention Center, and I think it is the most convenient location. It is close to public transportation and hotels. The accommodations are also excellent. The rooms are large, and we can reserve up to ten meeting rooms. However, the price is almost 50% more than we agreed we could spend. The other choice is the Mayfield Hotel. Many associations hold their conventions there. It is a nice place, and the price is reasonable. However, it is not close to the subway. Also, it is much smaller than the Convention Center. I think we could only get three meeting rooms. Would that be enough? Please get in touch with me today to let me know what you think. I need to reserve a place soon.

Martha

---
To: Martha Reynolds
From: Max Sullivan
Subj: Re: Conference

Martha,

In regard to selecting a location for the conference, I think the Convention Center is better than the Mayfield Hotel. The hotel is much too small. Remember, we plan to hold at least five sessions at a time. We couldn't do that at the hotel. We expect more people to take part in the convention this year, so it is important to have a space that can accommodate everyone. About the price, I think we can rearrange the budget a bit in order to be able to pay for it. So go ahead and reserve the space at the Convention Center.

Max

part1.instruction: Look at the picture and listen to the sentences. Choose the sentence that best describes the picture.

part1.translation: Nhìn vào bức tranh và chọn câu miêu tả đúng nhất: - (C) The duplicate photos are on the table.
part1.explanation: Trong bức ảnh, câu miêu tả chuẩn xác nhất hành động và bối cảnh là (C) 'The duplicate photos are on the table.'. Các phương án còn lại miêu tả sự vật hoặc hành động không có thật trong hình ảnh (bẫy gây nhiễu). Chọn C.

part2.spokenQuestion: Have you shut down your computer yet?

transcript.A: It's still on.
transcript.B: I just got my computer last week.
transcript.C: Here's the showdown.

part2.translation: Have you shut down your computer yet? - (A) It's still on.

part2.spokenQuestion: Do you want to duplicate it, or delete it?

part3.question: What happens when the man tries to access his e-mail?

options.text: A warning appears on the screen.

[M] I can't figure this out. When I tried to access my e-mail program, the monitor went black.
[W] It sounds like there's a problem with the display.
[M] Let me shut down the computer and then try one more time.
[W] If that fails to work, you should call in a repairperson right away. You shouldn't ignore a problem like this.
part3.translation: Điều gì xảy ra khi người đàn ông cố gắng truy cập email của mình? - (D) Màn hình chuyển sang màu đen.
part3.explanation: Người đàn ông nói: 'When I tried to access my e-mail program, the monitor went black.' (Khi tôi cố truy cập chương trình email, màn hình bị đen). Chọn D.

part3.question: What will the man do now?
part3.transcript:
[M] I can't figure this out. When I tried to access my e-mail program, the monitor went black.
[W] It sounds like there's a problem with the display.
[M] Let me shut down the computer and then try one more time.
[W] If that fails to work, you should call in a repairperson right away. You shouldn't ignore a problem like this.

options.text: Taking the computer back to the store.

part4.question: What does the speaker suggest that listeners do?

part4.transcript: I strongly urge you to read the manual before attempting to run this software program. You may be tempted to ignore this advice. But I'm warning you all: it is not likely that you will be able to figure out this program on your own. part5.question: In order to _______ your e-mail messages, you must type in your password.
part5.translation: Để _______ thư điện tử của bạn, bạn phải nhập mật khẩu vào.
part5.explanation: Cấu trúc chỉ mục đích 'In order to + V-bare' (để làm gì). Sau 'in order to' cần động từ nguyên mẫu không 'to'. Do đó chọn (A) access (truy cập).

part5.question: After reviewing the schedule, I realized we had not _______ enough time for the software training.
part5.translation: Sau khi xem lại lịch trình, tôi nhận ra chúng tôi đã không _______ đủ thời gian cho việc đào tạo phần mềm.
part5.explanation: Thì quá khứ hoàn thành dạng phủ định: 'had not + V3/V-ed'. Do đó ta cần dạng quá khứ phân từ của động từ allocate. Chọn (B) allocated (phân bổ/dành ra).

part5.question: The computer staff is responsible for making sure all system files are _______.
part5.translation: Nhân viên máy tính chịu trách nhiệm đảm bảo mọi tệp tin hệ thống đều được _______.
part5.explanation: Cấu trúc bị động ở hiện tại đơn: 'are + V3/V-ed'. Các tệp tin được sao lưu/nhân bản bởi con người, do đó cần dạng bị động. Chọn (B) duplicated (được nhân bản/sao lưu).

part5.question: _______ to examine the capabilities of the computer carefully has cost us a lot of time and money.
part5.translation: _______ kiểm tra kỹ các tính năng của máy tính đã làm chúng ta tốn rất nhiều thời gian và tiền bạc.
part5.explanation: Vị trí đứng đầu câu làm chủ ngữ cho vị ngữ 'has cost' cần một danh từ (Noun). Cấu trúc: 'Failure to do something' (việc không làm được gì / thất bại trong việc làm gì). Do đó chọn danh từ (B) Failure.

part5.question: She _______ the warning that the hard drive was full, and consequently they were unable to save the test data.
part5.translation: Cô ấy đã _______ lời cảnh báo rằng ổ cứng đã đầy, và do đó họ đã không thể lưu dữ liệu thử nghiệm.
part5.explanation: Câu trần thuật diễn tả chuỗi hành động trong quá khứ ('was full', 'were unable'). Mệnh đề chính đang thiếu động từ chính ở thì quá khứ đơn (V-ed). Chọn (B) ignored (đã phớt lờ/bỏ qua).

part5.question: The computer will _______ you to save your work before quitting.
part5.translation: Máy tính sẽ _______ bạn lưu công việc trước khi thoát chương trình.
part5.explanation: Sau trợ động từ khuyết thiếu 'will', ta luôn dùng động từ nguyên mẫu không 'to' (V-bare). Do đó chọn (C) warn (cảnh báo).

questions.question: Question 17 (Select the best word/phrase)

questions.question: Question 18 (Select the best word/phrase)
questions.translation: Câu hỏi 18: Điền từ thích hợp vào vị trí [18]

part7.title: Lesson 8: Office Procedures - Reading Comprehension
part7.passage: Questions 19—23 refer to the following article. When you bring in a new employee, it is important to make sure that he or she understands the usual omce procedures as well as the codes of behavior. These things should be outlined clearly in the employee handbook. New employees should understand that they are expected to do more than just glimpse at the handbook and then hide it in a drawer. A thorough reading of it will help them understand many things they need to know about the workplace culture. Employees also appreciate verbal reinforcement. Supervisors should let them know when they have completed a job well, or if they are bending the rules too far. More experi- enced coworkers can be asked to support new employees while they are getting used to their new positions and explain procedures to them, but ulti- mately it is the supervises responsibility to make sure that the normal offce practices are carried out. When everyone understands what is expected, then the offce procedures run more smoothly. In fact, it is not a bad idea to review the codes and procedures with the entire staff from time to time. This can be done on a regular basis at staff meet- ings, or it can be part of a training session.

Mentoring

way to provide new hires with the guidance they need to —1.7_ the responsibilities of their new position. With a
mentor in place, the new hire knows exactly who to go to when confused about policies and procedures. In addition,
many mentors conduct regular meetings with the people they are responsible for. This way they can make sure that
no serious problems arise. A mentor does not necessarily replace formal [17] programs. In fact, they often go hand
in hand. New hires may need a lot of support initially. Mentors are a good way to provide this.

part7.passage: Questions 19—23 refer to the following article. Designing retail space takes careful planning. Attention should be paid to what research tells us about consumer behavior. Stores must be designed with the comfort of shoppers in mind. The aisles should be wide enough to allow shoppers to move through them comfortably. Items should be placed where they can be easily seen by shoppers. Nothing should be put on high shelves where it cannot be reached. Pleasant lighting and music also contribute to the comfort and good feeling of shoppers. Shoppers who feel happy and relaxed will make more purchases. When organizing the merchandise in a store, the trends of each season should be kept in mind. Picnic and beach equip- ment should be prominently displayed in the summer, for example, while warm clothing should be featured in the uin- ter. Then, shoppers return to the store because they will see it as a place that provides what they need. There should be plenty of checkout aisles so that long lines are avoided. Many people cannot bear long waits, and long checkout lines scare shoppers away from stores. Many stores are now using self-service checkout aisles, although they have not yet been completely accepted by shoppers. They are often confusing to use, and many shoppers find them impersonal. The old-fashioned human cashier is still popular in most retail outlets. Therefore, it is säl_l considered mandatory for stores to have at least some full-service checkout lines manned by cashiers. When a store is properly designed, shoppers have a pleasant experience and will want to return. This helps the bottom line of the store 0'*mer which is, of course, increased sales.

Invoices are an essential part of any business and should be given their due attention. Without invoices, after all, a

part4.transcript: The most important factor in making your accounting firm profitable is to build up a solid list of clients. You want your clients to continue bringing their accounting business to you year after year and to avoid the problem of client tumover. Also, keep in mind that charging higher fees does not mean that you will make more money. If your clients feel that your fees are fair, they will recommend your services to their friends and colleagues. Finally, never forget what your most valuable asset is. It's easy to spend money on office equipment and rental fees for your space, but these are not the things that attract clients. It is important to make sure you have a team of excellent accountants on your staff. A qualified staff is the most valuable asset any accounting firm can have.

April I, 20 Mr. Roger Earnshaw 2943 Northern Boulevard New Orange, NH Dear Mr. Earnshaw, Enclosed are your completed forms, which I have prepared for you at your request. I am sorry to report that you will not receive the $500 refund that you expected. Instead, my calculations show that you owe $450 in as well as an additional penalty of $45 for underpayment of tues. The reason for this is that you and your spouse have chosen not to file your taxes jointly this year. You may want to reconsider tlüs for the future since, as you can see, it is more costly for married couples to file separately. If you and your spouse wish to continue to file separately, you may want to ask your employer to withhold a greater amount from your paychecks so that you dont end up owing money again next year. This will be even more important if you get the salary increase that you have been hoping for. Write out a check for the taxes that you still owe and the penalty and mail it together with your tax forms before the April 15 deadline. Please let me know if I can be of any further assistance. Sincerely, Kathleen O'Hara CPA

A budget can help the business owner determine the amount of profit the business is expected to make, the amount of sales it will take to reach a goal, and what [1] of expenses are attached to those sales. A business establishes a [2], a goal to work toward. A business [3] the sales that will be needed to reach this target. Projecting or planning ahead is part of [4] business planning. When creating a [5] income statement, a business owner tries to determine how to reach the [6] target. The annual profit must be sufficient to [7] the owner a return for his or her time spent operating the business, plus a return on the investment. The owner's target income is the sum of a reasonable salary for the time spent running the business and a normal return on the amount invested in the firm. After projecting the income needed, the business owner has to [8] the target profit into a net sales figure for the forecasted period. The owner has to determine whether this sales volume is [9]. One useful technique is to break down the required annual sales into a daily sales figure to get a better [10] of the sales required to yield the annual profit. At this stage in the financial plan, the owner should create a [11] picture of the firm's expected operating expenses. Expenses can be divided into fixed costs and variable costs. Fixed costs are costs that do not change based on sales volume, while variable costs change in direct relation to sales. By studying the expenses of a [12] firm in the same industry, the business owner can estimate appropriate amounts for each expense category.

part4.question: Who is this talk directed at?
part4.transcript: Questions 7 through 9 relaie to the following recording. Many small businesses fail because of poor financial advice. Remember, a small business is no different from a large company in that financial planning is the key to success. Therefore, creating a projected financial statement is the first and most important step one should take when starting up a small business. It is realistic to expect your small business to become profitable during its first five years, but typically not during the first year. With this in mind, you can set reasonable targets and project expenses for the first year or two of your business. This will help you know what funds you need to raise in order to get and keep your business going.

options.text: How to have a better staff meeting.

part4.transcript: In order to keep everyone from feeling that this meeting is a waste of time, I've developed the following guidelines. Please adhere to them. part7.title: Lesson 42: Theater - Reading Comprehension
part7.passage: Questions 19—23 refer to the following theater review. Audiences have waited a long time for the opening of the play Dusk to Dawn at the City Theater. Unfortunately, the long wait only adds to the dis- appointment of seeing a mediocre play. It is an uncomfortable experience frotn start to finish. The action is slow and the dialogue boring. The perfor- mance by most of the cast is awkward and, on the night I attended at least, many of the actors forgot their lines. They obviously did not rehearse enough before opening night, The plot is trite. Theatergoers had been told to expect a fresh approach to the age-old boy-meets-girl romance story. Instead, we get a story that is dull enough to dril.e one to tears. Although the play is relatively short—under two hours—the performance is so tedious it seems to dragon for three or four hours, The audience Inade an audible sigh of relief when the final curtain dropped. Rather than the predict- ed sold out performances, I expect that the play close very shortly. Unfortunately, the produc- ers invested a lot of money in this play, which they are not likely to get back. My advice to would-be theatergoers: spend the weekend at the movies instead.

part4.question: What is the class about?

part7.passage: Questions 19—23 refer to the following article. Caring for Your Health Your health is one of your most valuable assets, so caring for it properly is very important. When you call, you can also ask a few questions about the docto€s background, such as which university he got his degree from and how long he has been practicing in the area. You will also want to find out which hospi- tal the doctor is amated with. When you arrive for your appointment, make sure you bring a copy of your med- ica] records with you. It's very convenient to use. You just take it once a day, about thirty minutes before you go to bed. I'll give you a few free samples to try out. Call me in four or five days to jet me know how it's working. But I'm sure you'll be happy with it and want to fill the prescription. The only potential side effect it has is stomachaches, and it shouldn't have any interactions with your other medications. There's also no limit to the length of time you can use it. You can just keep on taking it as long as you feel a need.

part7.title: Lesson 50: Pharmacy - Reading Comprehension
part7.passage: Questions 19—23 refer to the following article. Many people don't realize that their pharmacist is an important member Of their health care team. If you always fill you prescriptions at the same phar- macy, then you have a pharmacist who is familiar with your medical issues and can detect any possible problems with your medications. In fact, it is a good idea to volunteer information about medications you are already taking when you visit a new pharmacist. Then, she can add this information to your records and have a complete file of information. She can monitor the drugs you are taking and let you know of any potential interactions or harm- ful side effects. If cost is an issue for you, your pharmacist can help. Ask her if there are any less expensive brands of your medication available. Or, you can request that she fill only half the prescription, to give you a chance to try out the med- ication before paying for the entire amount. You can also ask your doctor for a few free samples. Once you have ascertained that the prescribed medica- tion is working for you, you can go ahead and ask your pharmacist to fill the prescription for you. When you pick up your prescription, don't forget to ask the phannacist to explain to you how to take it if you have any doubts. She can also supply you with written instructions. Your pharmacist can provide you with important support, but there is a limit to what she can do. If you suspect that you have a problem that requires medical attention, you should always consult your doctor right away.
